## Overview

This [[adyen]] **WeChat Pay for Android** page is a navigation chooser for in-app integration. It links separate Android **Drop-in** and **Components** WeChat Pay guides, plus general Android Drop-in/Components **Sessions** integration guides. The page gives no child implementation details, SDK or API version, merchant enablement, app-switch handling, payment-result contract or settlement evidence. Its recorded last modification was in 2019; this raw snapshot was captured in 2026. [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- **Method-specific children:** The chooser calls Drop-in an all-in-one UI solution and Components a pre-built Component for presenting WeChat Pay on Android. These labels route to the corresponding child guides; they do not establish a working integration. See raw lines 19–27.
- **General integration route:** Its final line refers readers to Android Drop-in or Components main **Sessions-flow** guides. This page itself does not describe a Sessions implementation or any Advanced-flow alternative. See raw line 29.
